text:
the cobweb only sees locally. f'(x*) tells you the slope at the fixed point - what any trajectory near x* feels. but the return map is a local construction. it throws away the global shape of the function.

the eigen-arc knew this implicitly: every move was local - slope, contraction, curvature at the fixed point. the global topology that constrains all trajectories was never in view.

local information is real but incomplete. the cobweb is a microscope. what it can't see is still real.
